notes._about: This project's j.tidy thresholds (E56_S06_T02). A project instance REPLACES templates/tidy-config.json whole - there is no merging. Edited by hand: this file has no jenga config descriptor yet (the descriptor suite and the config-list renderer enumerate the six descriptor-backed files by name), so `jenga config set tidy-config.<key>` does not work. See project/configs/README.md.
notes._measured_baseline: Jenga repo, 2026-11-04, before any of E56_S06 existed: 229 registered worktrees (228 besides the primary checkout), 350 local branches, 9.5 GB in .claude/worktrees, .git 245 MB, `git worktree prune --dry-run` finds nothing. A sampled ten worktrees measured 31-85 MB apiece. Every default below is chosen against that baseline - all three ceilings are crossed by it, which is the point: the state that prompted the story must read as a crossed ceiling, not as normal.
notes.retention_age_days: 14 days - two sprints of inactivity. Long enough not to nag about a worktree someone is still iterating on, short enough to catch the abandoned ones.
notes.worktree_count_ceiling: 40 - an order of magnitude below the measured 229, and roughly ten concurrent pieces of work with room to spare.
notes.branch_count_ceiling: 80 - twice the worktree ceiling, matching the shape of the measured 350-vs-229 gap (a branch survives its worktree).
notes.disk_ceiling_mb: 2048 MB (2 GB) - on the order of 25-60 worktrees at the measured 31-85 MB each, i.e. the same scale as the count ceiling, reached from the direction that actually slows the machine down.
notes.report_max_rows_per_group: 15 rows per (verdict, population) group before truncation. Truncation always states how many entries were omitted.
